abilities.name: Broken Claim
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a sector matching your active Contract tag, advance that Contract by 1 valid progress step.

abilities.name: Ash Tithe
abilities.text: When you gain Salvage from a sector, gain +1 Salvage.

abilities.name: Crown Debt
abilities.text: Rivalry only. Once per round, after another operative in your sector gains Salvage, mark them; the next time you help or hinder them, gain 1 Salvage.

abilities.name: Ruin Courtesy
abilities.text: Once per round, after you enter a danger 2+ sector, record a private debt entry. Weakness: Broken Claim cannot gain bonus progress from blue Anomaly sectors.
